description: LTS (Long-Term Support) version pins for Conxian ecosystem SDKs and frameworks.

rust.note: MSRV for conxian-gateway Dockerfile and workspace crates

node.note: Required minimum for node:sqlite (≥22.5); matches B2C Wallet Suite CI

pnpm.note: Workspace package manager; enforced via --frozen-lockfile in CI

python.note: Used by scripts and clarity-sim; matches Unified CI setup-python

client-sdk.note: Pre-release. Define LTS at first stable (≥1.0.0). Consumers should pin exact.

schemas.note: Pre-release. Define LTS at first stable (≥1.0.0).

conxius-enclave-sdk.note: Rust workspace member. Follows root Cargo workspace version.

lib-conxian-core.note: Rust workspace member (submodule). Define LTS when stabilized.

next.js.note: Used by showcase-dapp and apps/control-plane. Pin exact in production.

react.note: React 19 is the supported version for all frontend surfaces.
